items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: As I understand it from Andy Hamilton’s book your parents were both born in Europe?

ctx.x: “Leon” was my given name and “Lee” has become my second name. The fact is that I had two older brothers and I was supposed to be a girl, and my name was going to be “Leonna”. So I became “Leon” and then after a while my friends called me “Leo”, and then “Lee”, and it’s going to “Le”. When I get to “L” I think I’m leaving town.
[Laughs] As I understand it from Andy Hamilton’s book your parents were both born in Europe?
Yes, my father in Austria, my mother in the Ukraine.
